# Ask Blockspace widget

> A framework-free embeddable web component (`<ask-blockspace>`) that answers Bitcoin blockspace questions with
> citations, backed by the Ask Blockspace API. It never gives price/investment advice and never asks for keys or
> seeds.

## Embed

```html
<script type="module" src="https://cdn.example/ask-blockspace.js"></script>
<ask-blockspace api-base="https://tutor.example"></ask-blockspace>
```

- `api-base` — base URL of the Ask Blockspace API (`POST {api-base}/v1/ask`). Omit it, or add the `fixture`
  attribute, to run the bundled offline demo with no server.
- `heading` — optional heading text.
- Emits a DOM `answer` event with the API response as `detail`.

## Backing API

- POST `{api-base}/v1/ask` with `{"question": string}` → `{answer, citations, groundedness, refused, ...}`.
- Contract: https://github.com/DegentClub/scribbit/blob/main/contracts/openapi/scribbit-tutor.yaml
- Policy: https://github.com/DegentClub/scribbit/blob/main/products/scribbit/packages/tutor-kb/POLICY.md

## Behaviour

- Answers are grounded in cited sources; refusals (price / keys / mainnet signing) render as a declined notice.
- All API text is inserted as text, never HTML — a response cannot inject markup.
- Accessible: keyboard reachable, visible focus, `aria-live` results, respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, WCAG AA
  contrast in light and dark.
